Showcase Details See the newest cohort pitch live October 22 in Traverse City About the Northern Michigan BlueTech Accelerator The Northern Michigan BlueTech Accelerator, Powered by gener8tor and anchored by 20Fathoms, is an intensive accelerator program based in Traverse City, MI.
It is purpose-built for early-stage founders working on water, freshwater, and BlueTech innovation.

The program combines gener8tor's proven accelerator curriculum with deep domain expertise, freshwater research infrastructure, and a regional investor community with a genuine stake in the future of water.

20Fathoms and gener8tor will recruit early-stage BlueTech startups from across the United States that are solving real problems in water, including infrastructure, treatment, monitoring, data, and climate-adjacent technologies.

It is home to 21% of the world's surface freshwater, working waterways for real-world testing, and a community that has been quietly building the infrastructure for a national BlueTech hub: The Freshwater Research & Innovation Center opens on West Grand Traverse Bay in 2027.
This accelerator is your opportunity to be a part of the foundation of that ecosystem and get in on the ground floor before it's fully built.
Who Should Apply The Northern Michigan BlueTech Accelerator is built for early-stage founders solving real problems in water: infrastructure, treatment, monitoring, data, and adjacent technologies.
If you're developing an innovative technology in the water sector, this accelerator is for you.
We're accepting applications from startups across the United States.
